# Weathermaster Door and Window Company

> Window, door, and glass company based in Fort Worth, Texas. Its commercial division is a window and door installation and replacement contractor serving Fort Worth, Dallas, and the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex since 1992. Weathermaster supplies and installs curtain wall, jumbo glass, storefront, and specialty glazing with its own crew and in-house glass robots. Its residential division supplies and installs windows and doors for luxury homes.

## Commercial services
- Facade and multi-story curtain wall
- Jumbo glass installation, set with in-house glass robots that lift panels weighing thousands of pounds (no crane rental needed)
- High rise glazing
- Storefront systems in steel, wood, clad, and other materials
- Fire rated door and window wall systems
- Custom doors, including imports from Germany, Italy, and Spain
- Ballistic windows
- Bomb blast door and window mitigation
- Historic window replication and restoration
- Custom multi-dimensional casting

## Residential windows and doors
- Custom windows in steel, wood, clad, vinyl, and other materials, including tall divided lites, arched heads, and picture windows
- Sliding and multi-panel glass doors (walls of glass that open the house to the terrace)
- Corner glass, including second-story corners
- Pivot and entry doors in wood, steel, bronze, and glass, including custom designs Weathermaster fabricates
- Jumbo glass set with Weathermaster's own glass robots
- Curved and arched glass, custom trim, and decorative detailing
- Window and door replacement in existing homes
- Built in Texas or imported from Germany, Italy, Spain, and other countries, including Unilux systems from Germany
- Works with homeowners, architects, interior designers, and custom home builders; free consultation with Joe Hiller

## How projects work
1. Free on-site consultation with Joe Hiller: drawings, access, floor heights, and panel sizes are reviewed before a number is given.
2. Spec and source: systems are matched to the spec, built in Texas or imported (America, Germany, Italy, Spain, and others), with lead times confirmed before ordering.
3. Install: Weathermaster's own trained crew and glass robots handle tight access, high floors, and heavy panels without extra subcontractors.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1992
- Based in: Fort Worth, Texas
- Service area: Fort Worth, Dallas, and the DFW metroplex (projects outside the area considered case by case)
- Works with: general contractors, architects, designers, and building owners, often as the glazing subcontractor
- Commercial and residential contact: Joe Hiller, (817) 689-7836, joe@weathermasterinc.com

## Notable projects
- The Star (historic high-rise), Houston, Texas: window installation
- W.T. Waggoner Building (built 1920), downtown Fort Worth: new windows
- Star-Telegram Building, Fort Worth: windows and decorative castings fabricated and installed
- Mule Alley at the Fort Worth Stockyards, including the Lucchese storefront: historic remake and window refurbishment
- Cinemark headquarters: new windows
- SMU campus, Dallas: custom windows
- Ennis City Hall, Ennis, Texas: historic upgrade
- Trinity Metro, Fort Worth: historic window renovation
- MorningStar Oil and Gas building: custom aluminum awnings
- Custom-designed and manufactured bronze doors
